title: Karanta kowane tsari, bincika ma'aunin ku kuma sake girman girman ku da tabbaci

say: Karanta kowane tsari, bincika ma'aunin ku, kuma ku sake girman girman ku da tabbaci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module ɗaya na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.
Karanta tsarin sau ɗaya, fara ƙarewa, kafin ka jefa ko sarka.
Duba kayan: za ku iya samun wannan zaren, kuma kuna da allura ko ƙugiya? Sai ma'aunin. Wanne dinki aka auna shi?

panel.heading: Duba sassa shida, ta wannan tsari
items: Materials: yarn, allura ko ƙugiya, ra'ayi
Ma'auni: stitches da layuka a cikin 10 cm

say: Zaɓi girman ku ta hanyar auna gama gari, ba ta harafin ba. Sannan kewaya kowace lamba don girman ku ta cikin tsarin gaba ɗaya, don haka ba za ku taɓa karanta tsakiyar layi ɗaya mara kyau ba.

panel.heading: Duba sassa shida, ta wannan tsari
items: Materials: yarn, allura ko ƙugiya, ra'ayi

say: Duba gajarta, sannan umarni. Ƙididdigar ɗinki a ƙarshen jere, kamar ɗigon 48, shine wurin binciken ku. Ƙidaya bayan kowane jere na siffa. A ƙarshe, karanta bayanan ƙarshe.

say: Ga kuskuren da za a guje wa. Sunan ɗaya yana nufin dinki daban-daban. Maƙalar Amurka guda ɗaya ce ta Burtaniya.
Idan kun bi tsarin Amurka tare da stitches na Burtaniya, kowane dinki yana da tsayi da tsayi, kuma yanki yana girma kuma ya fi girma fiye da yadda aka tsara.

panel.heading: Sharuɗɗan crochet na Amurka da na Burtaniya sun bambanta

say: Nemo alamu. Hanyoyin Amurka suna amfani da sc da hdc. Tsarin Burtaniya suna amfani da htr, kuma suna faɗin tashin hankali da kuskure maimakon ma'auni da tsallakewa.

panel.heading: Sharuɗɗan crochet na Amurka da na Burtaniya sun bambanta

say: A kan ginshiƙi, kowane murabba'i ɗinki ɗaya ne, kuma maɓallin yana bayyana kowace alama. Nemo layi 1. Yana a ƙasa, saboda masana'anta suna girma zuwa sama.

panel.heading: murabba'i ɗaya ɗinki ɗaya ne
items: Flat: Layukan gefen dama dama zuwa hagu
Lebur: Layukan gefen kuskure hagu zuwa dama

Ajiye mai mulki sama da layin aikinku
panel.rule: Layi na 1 yana ƙasa, saboda masana'anta suna girma sama.

say: Don saƙa lebur, karanta layuka na gefen dama daga dama zuwa hagu, da kuma layuka na gefen dama daga hagu zuwa dama.

say: A cikin zagaye, karanta kowane jere dama zuwa hagu, saboda koyaushe kuna fuskantar gefen dama. Ajiye mai mulki sama da layin da kuke aiki.

say: Ma'auni, wanda ake kira tashin hankali a cikin tsarin Burtaniya, shine yawan dinki da layuka da suka dace da cm 10. Mata biyu masu yarn iri ɗaya da allura suna iya samun ma'auni daban-daban.
Yi amfani da yarn ɗin aikin, kuma sanya swatch game da murabba'in 15 cm, saboda gefuna koyaushe ba daidai ba ne.

panel.heading: Yi swatch da za ku iya amincewa

Yi aiki da dinkin sunayen ma'auni
A wanke da bushe shi da kyau
Ƙidaya a fadin 15 cm, sannan raba

say: Yi aikin dinkin sunayen layin ma'auni. Sa'an nan kuma toshe shi yadda za ku wanke abin da aka gama: jiƙa, danna ruwa a cikin tawul, kuma bushe shi a hankali.

say: Auna a fadin 15 cm kuma raba. Rabin dinki a cikin santimita yana canza girman da yawa.

say: Misali, Funke a Ibadan tana yin tsallen auduga. Ma'aunin ƙirar shine 22 stitches zuwa 10 cm akan allura 4 mm, kuma gaba shine stitches 110.

panel.heading: Jumper Funke: me yasa stitches 2 ke da mahimmanci
items: Gyara: 3.5 mm allura, 33 a cikin 15 cm = 22

say: Wankin da aka wanke ta yana da dinki 30 a cikin santimita 15. Wannan shine 2.0 stitches a kowace cm, ko 20 a cikin 10 cm.

panel.heading: Jumper Funke: me yasa stitches 2 ke da mahimmanci
items: Gyara: 3.5 mm allura, 33 a cikin 15 cm = 22

say: Tsarin gaba zai zama 110 zuwa kashi 2.2, wanda shine 50 cm. Tsayinsa zai zama 55 cm. Gaba da baya tare, mai tsalle zai zama 10 cm babba a kusa.

panel.heading: Jumper Funke: me yasa stitches 2 ke da mahimmanci
items: Gyara: 3.5 mm allura, 33 a cikin 15 cm = 22

say: Yakinta yana kwance, don haka ta gangara zuwa allura 3.5 mm. Sabuwar swatch tana ƙirga 33 stitches a cikin 15 cm, daidai 22 a cikin 10 cm. Wata maraice na swatching ya ceci duk mai tsalle.

say: Lokacin da masu girma dabam ba su dace da jiki ba, za ku iya sake girma. Fara daga ma'aunin da aka gama da kuke so, gami da sauƙi, ba ma'aunin jiki ba.
Dinka daidai nisa nisa a cikin sau santimita dinki cikin santimita.

panel.heading: Dabaru uku don kowane girman

cards.d: Nisa manufa a cm x stitches da cm. Stitches a kowane cm shine ma'aunin ku zuwa kashi 10.
Tsawon manufa a cikin cm x layuka a cikin cm. Ƙara tsayi a cikin sassan fili, ba a cikin tsari ba.
Yarn yana tasowa tare da stitches: 20% fadi yana buƙatar kusan 20% ƙarin yarn. Sayi rini daya da yawa.

say: Layuka daidai tsawon lokacin niyya layuka cikin santimita. Ƙara tsayi a cikin ɓangaren fili a ƙasa da hannun hannu.

say: Misali, Grace a Jos na bukatar cardigan baya mai kimanin santimita 56. A stitches 2 a kowane cm, wato 112 dinki. Amma haƙarƙarin nata yana da yawa na 6 da 2.

panel.heading: Katin Grace: dace da maimaitawa
items: 112 minus 2 = 110, ba za a raba shi da 6 ba

say: 112 debe 2 shine 110, kuma 110 baya raba ta 6. Don haka 112 zai karya tsarin.

panel.heading: Katin Grace: dace da maimaitawa

say: Ƙididdigar mafi kusa da suka dace shine 110 ko 116. Ta zaɓi 110 stitches, baya na 55 cm, wanda har yanzu yana ba da kusan 8 cm na sauƙi.
Kada a ƙara dinki ɗaya ko biyu a tsakiyar maimaitawa. Zagaye zuwa ƙidayar da ta dace, sannan a sake duba faɗin.

say: Don tunawa. Duba sassan shida kowane lokaci. Ku sani idan sharuɗɗan rubutun ku na Amurka ne ko Burtaniya. Swatch 15 cm kuma wanke shi kafin aunawa. Nisa dinki ne da aka raba ta hanyar dinki cikin santimita. Kuma zagaye don dacewa da maimaitawa, sannan a sake duba faɗin.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: US single crochet = Burtaniya sau biyu crochet
Swatch 15 cm, wanke shi, sannan auna
Zagaye don dacewa da maimaitawa, sake duba faɗin

say: Yanzu yanke ƙirar tsaka-tsaki kyauta ɗaya, yi kuma yi wa lakabin ma'aunin ma'auni, sa'annan ku canza girman yanki ɗaya tare da ƙaramin zane na sabbin lambobinku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
